statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry)
The denial reason code was CO-197

statements.basis: denial_letter states CO-197 indicates required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained

statements.statement: The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness concerning for potential arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
